Top-down cost review updating the SGAB cost report (Landalv et al. 2017) with new data from Enerkem, GoBiGas, GTI, KIT, D3MAX and others. All costs in EUR with no price year printed (2020 assumed = publication year; the note '1 EUR = c. 1.15 USD' suggests 2018-2019 conditions); investment in EUR per kW of product output (8000 h/yr), production cost in EUR/MWh of product, default 10% finance over 15 years. Loaded per pathway: capex (Low/Medium/High as printed; ranges without a printed central value leave value blank), efficiency, other O&M as opex-total, production cost as cost-levelized, plus Enerkem Edmonton. Not loaded: feedstock supply, policy and incentive chapters (sections 5 and 6), learning-curve projections (other-values only for Tables 13-17). No emissions numbers.
